mini_task_spec:
Using the smartread brick's `imports` tool, read the file `test-repo/packages/core/nest-application.ts` and extract every unique import source path — i.e., the string that appears after `from` in each TypeScript `import { ... } from '...'` statement (both single-line and multi-line forms). Produce a deduplicated list of all such source paths, sorted alphabetically in ASCII/C-locale order (symbols < uppercase < lowercase; so paths starting with `./` come first, then paths starting with `@`, then plain names). Output one path per line, no surrounding quotes.
